quest.title: Owe Mora, Pay Mora
quest.description: Something seems to be troubling Goth...

dialogues.speaker: Goth
dialogues.text: *sigh* I suppose I might have to sort this out myself...

dialogues.speaker: Goth
dialogues.text: Ack, these old bones will fall apart at this rate...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there some urgent matter?

dialogues.speaker: Goth
dialogues.text: Oh, Traveler? Well, this... I wouldn't call it "an urgent matter," but it is getting out of hand for sure...

dialogues.speaker: Goth
dialogues.text: As you know, those Fatui have my hotel fully booked.

dialogues.speaker: Goth
dialogues.text: And as you know, I, as the boss of the Goth Grand Hotel, have to attend to them.

dialogues.speaker: Goth
dialogues.text: I coordinate food catering, repairs, and a slew of miscellaneous matters besides.

dialogues.speaker: Goth
dialogues.text: Lately, some rooms have had their furniture damaged, so I've had to contact people to bring the appropriate timber to some carpenters.

dialogues.speaker: Goth
dialogues.text: Then there's the matter of collecting rent on a few apartments... and the matter of my lad Marvin being nowhere to be found.

dialogues.speaker: Goth
dialogues.text: *sigh* I wonder how long I can last... Or when that boy will finally grow up...

response.speaker: Goth
response.text: You're willing to help? Ah, that's wonderful! ... *sigh* If only that loud Marvin had as good a head on his shoulders as you. That would've spared me much trouble...

response.speaker: Goth
response.text: In that case, could I trouble you to fetch some Fir Wood and Birch Wood? I'll need to have them sent to the carpenters soon.

dialogues.speaker: Goth
dialogues.text: Have you obtained the timber? I just need one set of Fir Wood and another of Birch Wood.

dialogues.speaker: Goth
dialogues.text: Thank you so much. These should do. Now to send them off to the carpenter... Oh. Right! I need to collect rent as well...

dialogues.speaker: Goth
dialogues.text: *sigh* I just wonder if that... As... Astromona, or whatever she was called, will be in this time...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's Mona Megistus, the Astrologist.

dialogues.speaker: Goth
dialogues.text: Right! Yes, that was her name... Ugh. It's a bit long, if you ask me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Mona hasn't paid her rent, you say?

dialogues.speaker: Goth
dialogues.text: Well, that's just the thing, see? All my other tenants have already paid theirs. She's the only one left.

dialogues.speaker: Goth
dialogues.text: I came by a few times previously, but she wasn't in.

dialogues.speaker: Goth
dialogues.text: So please, Traveler, help me go down there and urge her to pay up soon, would you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The Knights of Favonius Library, I'd say.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The library... Ooh, that's right! The library's a pretty big place. Maybe she's looking for research materials in there!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, time to get moving!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good Hunter. I hear there's salad to be had there.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Good Hunter... Hmm... Right, maybe she's gone there for some salad. Let's go have a look.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, that's assuming she has enough Mora on hand to buy salad...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's just go to Katheryne directly.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Katheryne, huh? That's a good pick for sure — she knows basically everything, after all!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, let's get going!

talks.objective: Look for Mona in the library

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, no sign of Mona. Lisa isn't in, either.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's go ask that Knight at the door. Maybe he's seen Mona.

dialogues.speaker: Wyratt
dialogues.text: Hello. How may I assist?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Excuse me, have you seen a girl who looks something like this...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You describe Mona's distinguishing features to Wyratt...

dialogues.speaker: Wyratt
dialogues.text: Oh! I know who you're talking about. It's the girl with the really big hat!

dialogues.speaker: Wyratt
dialogues.text: She often comes by to consult some of the texts we keep here. She spends the whole day reading, so she's quite the memorable patron.

dialogues.speaker: Wyratt
dialogues.text: That said, she hasn't swung by recently. I doubt you'll find her hereabouts...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Seems we're a little late.

dialogues.speaker: Wyratt
dialogues.text: If she does come by, I'll make sure to tell her that you're looking for her.

dialogues.speaker: Wyratt
dialogues.text: That's all I can do for you in this case, unfortunately...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No problem. Thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Wyratt
dialogues.text: Think nothing of it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, looks like Mona's not in the library. Guess we've got to tell Goth that we couldn't find her...

talks.objective: Go to Good Hunter to look for Mona

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Hi there! Would you like to order anything?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Excuse me, have you seen a girl who looks something like this...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You describe Mona's distinguishing features to Sara...

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Oh, you mean Mona, don't you? At one time, she came by every evening to grab some salad — she sometimes even asked me for an extra egg or two.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Guess she's as short of Mora as ever, huh...

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: She hasn't come once in the past few days, though.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: If you're in a hurry to find her, I can pass a message on to her for you the next time she comes by to get salad.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like Mona hasn't been to Good Hunter. Ugh, guess we've got to go tell Goth that we couldn't find her today...

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Hello, how may I help you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you seen Mona recently?

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: Mona? Hmm... No, I can't say I have...

dialogues.speaker: Katheryne
dialogues.text: If you're in a hurry to find her, why not post a commission here at the Guild?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thanks, but we'll look for her ourselves.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm. Katheryne's got no clue where Mona is. Guess it's back to Goth to tell him that we couldn't find her today...

dialogues.speaker: Goth
dialogues.text: How did it go? Were you able to find that Ast... Well, your friend?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: She doesn't seem to be home today.

dialogues.speaker: Goth
dialogues.text: Well, alright that. She doesn't really owe that much rent. We can put it off for a few days.

dialogues.speaker: Goth
dialogues.text: Ah, yes. Please take these for your help in the meantime.

dialogues.speaker: Goth
dialogues.text: As... Astro... Hmm, what was her name again?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Mona, are you home?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Mona, it's rent time!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh. Mona really doesn't seem to be home...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's weird. Isn't she cooped up in that house most of the time? Is she out on some business?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Or maybe she's unable to come to the door, faint from hunger as she is?

choices.text: I doubt things are that bad...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But where should we go to find Mona...

choices.text: Didn't she say that she's found some way to make money?
